title: Bulk edit ergonomics: mark everything high priority
description: Probes whether the agent discovers vikunja_task_bulk / bulk-update rather than updating each task one at a time (docs/API_NOTES.md's 'Bulk Operations' section). RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning at the time -- create-project (1) + bulk-create 8 tasks (1) + bulk-update(field: priority, value: 5, taskIds: all 8) (1) = 3. The prompt itself prescribes the process ('Then, in one bulk update, mark all 8 of them...'), i.e. create-then-retroactively-update is the literal ask, not merely one possible end state -- so setting priority 5 at creation time (which would also satisfy the verify checks) is not a faithful solve of what was asked and stays excluded from the optimum. RE-BASELINED 2026-09-02 (issue #202), closing the 2026-08-31 outstanding-work note in docs/BATTLE-TESTING.md that flagged this optimum as likely stale: the CREATION half of the 2026-07-25 estimate (create-project + bulk-create = 2 calls) predates `setup-kanban`'s `columns` becoming optional (issue #185), which collapses it to ONE call -- `title` + `tasks: [{title}]` x8, no `priority` set (the prescribed-sequence exclusion above still applies: the priority change must still happen in a SEPARATE, later `bulk-update` call, never front-loaded) and no `columns` (no Kanban structure fabricated). New optimum: setup-kanban columns-less (1) + bulk-update(field: 'priority', value: 5, taskIds: all 8) (1) = 2.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Backlog Cleanup" with 8 tasks named "{{prefix}}item-1" through "{{prefix}}item-8". Then, in one bulk update, mark all 8 of them as high priority (priority 5).
